evidence_read.attribution: Retained author stdout/stderr/receipts were read; these are author results, not executions by Forge. Root separate 34-command receiving is not reissued or included as this review.

findings: All five final bodies and 16 runtime-projection rows independently match frozen length/SHA256/Git blob/mode. Full original projection comparison identifies exactly README.md and testpilot/__main__.py modified, 19 inherited files unchanged, and exactly history.py, test_history.py and HISTORY.md added. Both complete modified-file diffs equal retained additive patches.

The history dispatch returns before existing execution paths. New scanner imports only stdlib and treats saved paths, source, code, timestamps and outcomes as recorded values; it does not open recorded paths or invoke tests/models. Other CLI bodies remain byte-exact after removing the reviewed additive import/parser/dispatch blocks.

Option admission precedes path access. Explicit root symlink resolution is separate from skipped internal symlinks. Entry collection completes before sorted depth-first traversal; an overflowing or interrupted local enumeration cannot leak its arbitrary partial listing into selected rows.

Candidate counting, per-file type/size admission, remaining total allowance and captured-byte accounting follow both public addenda. Global stopping conditions are explicit; per-file errors preserve later healthy siblings. Every candidate is admitted before row filters, so filters cannot conceal neighbor problems or reduce scan work.

Descriptor reads are unbuffered in v2 and individually limited to remaining byte allowance. Complete source comparison proves exactly one fdopen buffering argument changed from preserved v1. Descriptor type/size checks and acquired-size comparison are coherent within the documented non-concurrent, non-hostile scope.

Finite UTF-8/BOM JSON decoding rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite decoded numbers at all nesting levels; typed core validation excludes booleans from integer fields. Literal path, target and test-name query/filter semantics are separated from unsearched source/diagnostic bodies.

Text and JSON use ASCII-safe encoding for recorded values; output flush failure returns 2 without a rescan or automatic writer retry. The guide accurately distinguishes selected-scope completeness, partial results, saved claims and output failures.
limits: No full repository remote tree, publication ancestry or current-head adoption audit is claimed here; those remain publication gates.
The scanner does not provide a hostile-path boundary, writer snapshot, recorded-outcome authentication or chronology inference.
The bounded raw-read correction prevents Python buffered read-ahead; this is not an OS page-cache/disk-I/O limit claim.
The current receiver review was completed before this candidate exposure and remains a separate sealed artifact.
scope: Full read-only review of the five final candidate source/test/doc bodies, original-to-candidate source fence, preserved v1-to-v2 correction and relevant author evidence. No product or test execution.
